title: fix(app-shell): match sys_user.locale in the server resolveLocale order
body:
Refs #30050 (half 2)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:控制台按用户的 `sys_user.locale` 选界面语言时,改用与服务端 `resolveLocale` 相同的匹配顺序(精确 → 忽略大小写 → 基础语言 → 同语言变体)。
- 为什么改:原来只做精确匹配和基础语言匹配。存成 `zh-cn` 的历史行,或 `zh` / `zh-Hans-CN` 这类标签,在部署只提供 `zh-CN` 时匹配不到,中文用户看到的是英文界面。
- 风险与回滚:只改 `pickRenderableLocale` 一个纯函数,不碰服务端和数据;回滚即还原这一个提交。匹配不到的语言仍然什么都不切换,与原行为一致。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useUserLocale.ts` 的 `pickRenderableLocale`(四步匹配);`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/userLocale-10059.test.tsx` 末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证:在 `ui/` 下跑 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/userLocale-10059.test.tsx`,预期 18 条全部通过,其中 `zh-cn`、`zh`、`zh-Hans-CN` 都解析到 `zh-CN`,`en-GB` 解析到 `en`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`pickRenderableLocale` picks the console's UI language for a signed-in user's `sys_user.locale`. It now resolves in the same order as the server's i18n routes, which use `resolveLocale` in `packages/core` `fallbacks/memory-i18n.ts`:

1. exact tag;
2. the same tag in any case (`zh-cn` → `zh-CN`). This covers a row written before the server door folded case: such rows are not migrated and are served as stored;
3. base language, in any case (`en-GB` → `en`; `zh-CN` → `zh` when a `zh` pack is offered);
4. the first offered variant of the base language (`zh` → `zh-CN`, `zh-Hans-CN` → `zh-CN`).

A match returns the offered spelling. A tag that shares no language with any offered locale still matches nothing, so the device language keeps deciding, as before.

The matcher stays in app-shell. `@objectstack/core` exports `resolveLocale`, but app-shell does not depend on it, and it is a server kernel package. The `@object-ui/i18n` `matchLanguageTag` takes a predicate, not a list, so it cannot express the variant step. Widening it would also change the seed and catalogue lookups, which this card does not cover.

## Tests

A new top-level `describe` in the existing harness `userLocale-10059.test.tsx` pins these cases:

- case fold;
- bare language to variant;
- script-tagged tag to variant;
- unoffered region to base;
- base preferred over a sibling variant;
- first offered variant wins;
- an unknown tag and an empty list give no match;
- end to end: `I18nProvider` mounted with `loadLocales` answering `['en', 'zh-CN']` and a column of `zh` renders `zh-CN`.

The existing `pickRenderableLocale` cases are kept unchanged: exact `pt-BR`, `zh-CN` → `zh`, `th` refused, and the list still in flight.

All runs below are on head `218415004` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`), from the worktree, after the final commit.

<details><summary>Reverse verification: the origin/main matcher turns 6 of the 8 new pins red</summary>

With the fix committed, `useUserLocale.ts` was restored from merge base `55337f4ce` in the tree only. On disk that left 0 `caseMatch` lines and 1 `offerable.includes(base)` line. The suite was re-run, then the file was restored with `git checkout HEAD --` under a trap. After the restore, the file hash matched the HEAD blob `dd0da66e` and `git diff HEAD` was empty.

```text
     x folds case to the offered spelling (a legacy mis-cased row)
     x expands a bare language to the offered variant
     x reaches the offered variant through a script-tagged tag
     x falls back to the base language for an unoffered region
     x takes the first offered variant when several share a base
     x renders the offered variant for a bare column, end to end

```

Two of the new pins are expected to stay green on the old code, because both behaviours already held before: base over variant (`pt-PT` → `pt`) and no match (`th-TH`, `xx-YY`, empty list).
</details>

`pnpm exec turbo run type-check --concurrency=2 --filter=./ui/packages/app-shell` ran `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. Result: `Tasks: 68 successful, 68 total`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

## Acceptance notes

- The matcher copies `resolveLocale`'s order rather than importing it, for the dependency reasons given under What changes.
- `@object-ui/i18n`'s seed and catalogue lookup (`matchLanguageTag`) still matches exact, then base, with no case fold. The built-in packs are keyed by base language (`zh`), so a mis-cased seed such as `zh-cn` still reaches `zh` through the base step. No wrong answer was reproduced, so this is noted here and not filed.
- Half 1 of the card (the server door in `plugin-auth`) is not touched. Triage did not file it.
